verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents escalation behavior: topic-scoped deployment that leaves untrained topics to the human team, response guardrails that can escalate, and specialist/regulatory escalations that carry full interaction history into a human handoff on the same platform. Simulations and guardrail test scenarios also give some way to check that escalation logic holds. Missing for 10: configurable handoff triggers for sentiment, customer tier, or explicit human-request; documented rule-configuration UI or controls for escalation conditions; independent or hands-on evidence that handoffs reliably fire as configured.
